summary: Iteration 5: Tested the three new PLENA SNAP features (QR share, slideshow, intro cinematic) plus regression. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass for /api/share/{id} and /api/images/{id}?dl=1. Frontend: cinematic letter animation, slideshow (render/auto-rotate/3 exit paths), gallery regression and the full generation -> result-view QR flow (ONE Gemini call used, succeeded in <120s) all pass. Share page verified end-to-end in a mobile browser viewport. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: HEAD returns 405 (route registered for GET only). GET works correctly with Content-Disposition. Harmless for browsers/QR flow, but some link previewers/CDNs probe with HEAD.
Share HTML has no Open Graph/Twitter meta tags, so WhatsApp/iMessage previews of the shared link show no thumbnail. Nice-to-have for an event booth.

action_items: OPTIONAL: add OG/Twitter meta tags (og:image -> /api/images/{id}) to SHARE_PAGE for rich link previews.
OPTIONAL: allow HEAD on /api/images/{id} (methods=['GET','HEAD']) so probes don't 405.
critical_code_review_comments: SlideshowView: document.documentElement.requestFullscreen() is called on mount without user-gesture guarantee in some browsers; it is already .catch()-ed so it degrades gracefully (verified headless - view still fills the screen via fixed inset-0).
SlideshowView rotation interval depends only on creations.length, so the 60s refresh does not reset the 6s timer - correct behaviour, no drift observed.

AttractScreen flash overlay uses position fixed + z-30 inside the tap-to-start button; measured opacity settles to 0 after 1.5s and it is pointer-events-none, so it never blocks the start tap (verified: tap-to-start worked).
ResultView download uses a base64 data URL anchor (works), while the QR points at the server-side /api/share/{id} route - both paths verified.
seed_data_creation: One new creation generated via the single permitted Gemini call: id a7e32b2d-4a6c-460e-ac77-b72d5e01fba6 (total creations now 24). Nothing deleted; event logo untouched; ADMIN_PIN not used.

Verified in browser: intro cinematic (4 SNAP letter spans animate, flash overlay opacity returns to 0, no layout break); slideshow (image naturalWidth=1200, counter 1/23 -> 2/23 after ~7s, exits via X button, ESC and click-anywhere all return to gallery); gallery grid 24 items, detail modal image renders (naturalWidth=1200) with print/download/delete buttons; result-view QR block renders an 84x84 SVG QR; share page at /api/share/{id} renders branded HTML with image + 'JPG Olarak İndir' linking to ?dl=1 (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=plena-snap-{id}.jpg). Gemini budget for this run is exhausted - do NOT trigger another generation unless explicitly authorised.
